headline: Tempest Island Flares; Fishermans Row Still in Heavy Fight
war_summary: Since the last edition, Tempest Island has flared into action, a strategic base changing hands shortly after 1 a.m. Stema Landing likewise remains unsettled, its latest move logged at 11:52 p.m. Fishermans Row still dominates the base board with twenty-three recorded changes over the past day, though the last two hours have been quiet there. DeadLands, carrying fourteen daily changes, has gone still since 7 p.m. Godcrofts broke its calm with a fresh event at 11:25 p.m., while Lykos Isle has seen five shifts, the latest near 10 p.m. Farranac Coast has not stirred since 5:50 p.m., and Linn Mercy remains dormant. Clahstra and Weathered Expanse continue to pile up casualties without any strategic bases changing hands. The war enters its eighty-third day with the ledger still split and neither side at the required victory total.
